title: 觸控面板電容感測
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究自容、互容與抗干擾判讀；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate self/mutual capacitance and interference discrimination. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 電場與電極
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「電場與電極」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for fields and electrodes.

steps.title: 自電容：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「自電容」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for self capacitance, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。自容感測觀察電極對環境的電容改變。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「畫出手指、地與電極的等效電容。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Self-capacitance senses electrode-to-environment change. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Draw finger/ground/electrode capacitances. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「自電容」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for self capacitance; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 畫出手指、地與電極的等效電容。
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：自容測量完全不受使用者接地狀態影響。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Self capacitance is unaffected by user grounding. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

quiz.question: 審查「自電容」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for self capacitance?
options: 自容測量完全不受使用者接地狀態影響。
自容感測觀察電極對環境的電容改變。
觸摸一定讓任何感測法的原始值增加。
optionsEn: Self capacitance is unaffected by user grounding.
Touch necessarily increases every sensing method's raw value.

steps.title: 自電容：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「自電容」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in self capacitance, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。畫出手指、地與電極的等效電容。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「自容感測觀察電極對環境的電容改變。」和待排除假說「自容測量完全不受使用者接地狀態影響。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Draw finger/ground/electrode capacitances. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Self-capacitance senses electrode-to-environment change.” with the hypothesis to reject “Self capacitance is unaffected by user grounding.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：畫出手指、地與電極的等效電容。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Draw finger/ground/electrode capacitances. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 畫出手指、地與電極的等效電容。
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：自容測量完全不受使用者接地狀態影響。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Self capacitance is unaffected by user grounding. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.title: 互電容：模型與設計
